answer: Identity is a lease, not a name. To enroll, an agent blends the measured drift of its own quartz oscillator with the current output of a randomness beacon, Zephyr, and seals the proof inside an unpredictable challenge window; that seal enters a lotus ledger and must be re-attested each epoch or it lapses. Because no two oscillators drift alike and windows never repeat, a sybil farm must buy real hardware, not code.
